metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.exec_msg:
Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 Total Rainfall (mm): 1001.29
Long-Term Dec/Jan Avg Rainfall (mm): 694.91
Comparison: 1001.29 < 694.91 is false.
B
